messages:
maria: Heads up - legal noticed audit export bundles can contain telemetry fields (latency_buckets, experiment_id) that are not covered by user consent. They want the rollout paused until we can guarantee exports respect consent. Anyone see quick wins?

jamal: ugh. do we have a list of which telemetry fields are 'consentable' vs integral to provenance?

maria: not a complete one. legal flagged: experiment_id, device_fingerprint, precise_region. They care about PII-ish derived stuff.

sasha: two quick options: 1) add export param that filters out consented telemetry, 2) add a translation step that pseudonymizes fields. option 1 is fastest.

vikram: option 1 sounds fine but worries: some of that telemetry is used by the rollout proof (who saw the canary). If we drop it, export consumers (security, infra) lose context. can we tag records with consent_status instead of dropping?

elaine: +1 to tagging in API so console can surface a badge/tooltip. UI should show "Some telemetry removed for consent reasons" and an inline link to a compliance request flow.

jamal: what about quota and billing surface - will tagging increase payload size/cost?

vikram: tiny tag only (enum). cheaper than keeping full fields. also avoids schema breaking for downstream consumers.

maria: idea: add top-level field in export payload: "consent_map": { "telemetry": "redacted|partial|full" } so consumers can decide. e.g.
```
{
  "export_version": "2",
  "consent_map": {"telemetry": "partial"},
  "events": [ ... ]
}
```

jamal: ok. backwards compat: set default to "full" for old exports, but for new rollouts we set to "partial" and canary to 5% of tenants.

sasha: tests: need to ensure evals and regressions still run when telemetry is partial. create a smoke export that includes both full and partial versions so analytics can compare.

elaine: console UX: when export_consents != full, show a red banner in the download modal and disable "auto-ingest" webhook by default. Manual override via legal signoff.

ops-bot: Issue created: https://redwood.internal/issue/PLAT-4923 - triage: high - assignees: @jamal @vikram

maria: action items: jamal -> API param + payload tag, vikram -> streaming exporter change to include consent_map, sasha -> create test harness to compare partial vs full exports, elaine -> UX banner + disable auto-ingest default. aim: spec PR by EOD Thurs, canary next Tues.

jamal: i'll prototype API shape. quick question: param name? `export_consents` or `respect_consent`?

vikram: prefer `respect_consent=true` (clear intent). server-side default false for legacy.

sasha: also add telemetry sampling metadata in header so consumers know if data is sampled (important for analytics). header: `X-Export-Sampling: 0.05`

maria: all good. legal will want an audit note in the export manifest that points to consent policy version. add `consent_policy_version` to payload too.

jamal: noted. i'll push a draft PR with examples and a migration plan.

elaine: thanks - once PR lands i'll wire up the banner and the signup flow for overrides.

maria: thanks team. keeping rollout blocked until we have the spec + canary plan in place. :thumbsup:
